posts.name: Edwin
posts.cooked: Ahah, another Culture fan!  Sadly Phlebas is the first of the books, and is generally not said to be as good.  PoG is almost certainly the best; out of the five I've read, I would recommend Inversions most after PoG (it's only barely a culture book, but the philosophy is woven throughout in a really compelling way), followed by the Hydrogen Sonata, Excession, and Use of Weapons.  I have Phlebas but haven't gotten to it yet.
